scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only

conservation.missing_values: exclude and report coverage; never replace with zero

review_filter: No additional review-status exclusion; sensitivity analysis did not replace primary cohort
evaluation: Use the existing gene-disjoint test split, report eligible-row and class coverage, compare six and eight features on identical eligible test rows. Fit both models on the same 679 training rows. No test-based tuning.
prior_test_use: The three-feature baseline was already evaluated on this split. The eight-feature configuration was selected using training-only cross-validation; this is not a new independent dataset.
scope: Research prototype; uncalibrated scores are not clinical risk estimates
